A [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''communications officer''' served on the transport ''[[Record Time]]'' during the initial [[Battle of Borleias (Yuuzhan Vong War; Second)|landing]] made by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] on [[Borleias/Legends|Borleias]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. He served under [[Ninora Birt]] during the landing.
